newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul Exchange to list 2nd real estate trust.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul Exchange to list 2nd real estate trust.

text.p: Istanbul's Stock Exchange said on Wednesday it would list 125 billion lira nominal-valued shares representing 33.33 percent of the capital of Vakif real estate investment trust on January 13.
The opening price of each 1,000 lira nominal-valued share will be 2,000 lira, the Exchange said.
It will be the second real estate investment trust to list part of its shares on the Istanbul market after Alarko real estate trust which began trading on January 2.

Vakif trust had sold 125 billion lira of its shares to 977 individual and five institutional investors in a two-day offer last month, although it put on sale 250 billion lira of new shares to double its capital to 500 billion lira.
The trust's capital was set at 375 billion lira after the public offer due to unsold shares which were later cancelled.

State-owned Vakifbank remained as the biggest shareholder with 36.67 percent stake after the offer, followed by state land directorate with 16.67 percent. Four companies and two pension funds associated with Vakifbank hold 26.66 percent stake.
The trust holds a portfolio which consists of capital market tools based on real estate development, building and land projects and real estate investments made to earn rent.
